topic: Buggy's Chop-Chop Fruit: blades fail, blunt force hurts, and sensation is the hidden weak point
title: Buggy's Chop-Chop Fruit Makes Swords Useless
description: Buggy's Chop-Chop Fruit lets him split his body and steer the pieces, so most swords can't finish him. This Short covers the three limits that matter: blunt force still hurts, he can't swim, and every separated piece still feels what happens to it. Which of those limits do you think matters most?
comment: Is Buggy's sensation weakness a real flaw, or a design choice that's secretly brilliant?

lines.text: Buggy can split his body, and swords can't finish him.

shot.fallback: anime style, a clown-like pirate's body split into floating pieces

lines.text: Any edged attack just splits him apart, and the pieces snap back into place.

shot.fallback: anime style, scattered pirate pieces pulling back together

lines.text: But the fruit has three limits, and this is the part most fans skip.

shot.fallback: anime style, three glowing limits around a devil fruit

lines.text: Blunt force still hurts him, because only edged attacks fail.

shot.fallback: anime style, a fist striking a clown-like pirate

lines.text: He also can't swim anymore, so water is a real problem.

shot.fallback: anime style, a pirate struggling near the surface of the sea

lines.text: The sneakiest weakness is sensation, and most fans underrate it.

shot.fallback: anime style, a pirate with glowing nerve lines running through floating pieces

lines.text: A separated piece still feels whatever happens to it.

shot.fallback: anime style, a floating hand flinching

lines.text: Luffy exploited that, hitting a separated torso in a painful spot.

shot.fallback: anime style, a straw hat pirate striking a floating torso

lines.text: So the fruit is a shield with a nerve running straight through it.

shot.fallback: anime style, a glowing shield with a nerve line running through it

lines.text: Pick a side, because a man who splits his body is never really finished.

shot.fallback: anime style, a pirate staring with a steady gaze
